newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway's PGS says proposes equity offering.
newsitem.headline: Norway's PGS says proposes equity offering.

text.p: Norwegian seismic exploration company Petroleum Geo-Services on Thursday said it proposed to make a public offering of 4.6 million American Depositary Shares (ADS).

The figure included 600,000 ADSs to cover over-allotment, and represented the same number of ordinary shares of the company, the company said in a press release. The company's ADSs are included on Nasdaq and its ordinary shares are listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange.
The company said it intended to file a registration statement relating to the securities to be offered with the Securities and Exchange Commission in the near future.
